quotes.text: "Should set password if one was provided"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The port removes checkPassword assertions that directly checked the old/new password values. The QR helper instead calls changePassword and asserts whether hasPassword matches the presence of a new password; the privacy test retains password-present and checkbox-state assertions after removing its direct value check. Accepted QR source later awaits changePassword. Keep presence/state assertions separate from a direct chosen-password-value assertion. This is inspected test code, not a new token or browser-test result.
title: The token API port narrows the primary-password helper's direct assertion targets
